verses.text: This is Solomon's Song of Songs, the most beautiful song of all.
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth, for your love is better than wine.
Your perfumed oils smell wonderful. Your name is like perfume poured out. That is why the young women love you.

Take me away with you. Let us hurry! The king has brought me into his rooms. The friends say: We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! She says: They are right to love you.
I am dark but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, dark like the tents of Kedar, lovely like Solomon's curtains.
Do not stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has burned my skin. My mother's sons were angry with me. They made me take care of the vineyards, so I have not taken care of my own vineyard.
Tell me, you whom my heart loves, where do you feed your flock? Where do you let them rest at noon? Why should I be like a woman wearing a veil, wandering beside the flocks of your friends?
If you do not know, most beautiful of women, follow the tracks of the sheep, and feed your young goats beside the shepherds' tents.
My love, I compare you to a fine horse pulling Pharaoh's chariots.
Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, and your neck with strings of jewels.
We will make you earrings of gold, decorated with silver.
While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its sweet smell.
My beloved is to me like a little bag of myrrh resting between my breasts.
My beloved is to me like a cluster of henna flowers from the vineyards of En Gedi.
Look, you are beautiful, my love. Look, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.
Look, you are handsome, my beloved, and so pleasant! Our bed is green and fresh.
The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are fir trees.
